cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:a6.description: Our client is a well-established and growing provider of industrial services supporting manufacturing and production facilities across a broad regional footprint. They are known for delivering high-quality solutions, maintaining strong client partnerships, and operating with a consistent focus on safety, efficiency, and operational excellence. As the organization continues to expand, our client is seeking a driven and strategic Business Development Director. This role will focus on identifying new business opportunities, strengthening key relationships, and driving revenue growth across priority markets. The ideal candidate will bring strong industrial services experience, a proactive approach to business development, and the ability to align sales strategy with overall company objectives.
responsibilities: New Business Development & Revenue Generation
Identify and develop new customer relationships across target industries

Generate and qualify opportunities leading to RFQs and new accounts

Drive revenue growth and support capacity utilization goals
Sales Execution & Process Discipline

Position precision machining, short-run, and rapid-turn capabilities effectively
Maintain a solution-oriented approach to opportunity qualification

Sales Strategy & Positioning
Communicate core capabilities and value proposition clearly
Position the company as a responsive, high-value manufacturing partner
Leverage speed, capacity, and problem-solving as key differentiators
Team Integration & Growth
Align sales activity with leadership and operational capacity
Support future sales team development as the function scales
Contribute to a high-accountability, performance-driven culture
Internal Alignment & Improvement
Provide market and customer feedback to leadership
Identify opportunities to improve conversion, responsiveness, and experience
Ensure alignment between sales activity and production capability

The role combines customer-facing solution architecture, pre-sales engineering, technical delivery, and post-launch support. You will design solutions around real-world customer environments, technical constraints, and data-residency requirements while building reusable patterns that can accelerate future engagements. As the first dedicated technical presence for the region, you will also shape the regional playbook and influence product development through direct customer insights. The environment is fast-moving, AI-first, globally distributed, and highly collaborative, with significant autonomy and technical ownership. jobgether-jobgether:lever:79bebfc3-4c33-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Creative Strategist (Paid Social) based in Brazil. This is a performance-focused creative strategy role centered on paid social advertising, with Meta as the primary channel. You’ll turn customer insights, advertising data, and consumer psychology into concepts that capture attention and drive measurable conversions. Your responsibilities will span creative ideation, direct-response copy, performance analysis, testing, and detailed creative briefing. You’ll work closely with designers, video editors, UGC creators, and performance marketing specialists to bring winning concepts to life. While the role also contributes to landing pages, website messaging, and organic content, paid advertising performance remains the core priority. You’ll have the autonomy to test ideas, identify opportunities, and continuously improve the creative system based on evidence rather than personal preference. It’s an ideal environment for a commercially minded strategist who combines creativity with analytical thinking and thrives in a fast-moving DTC setting. Develop high-performing paid social concepts, hooks, angles, scripts, and creative ideas primarily for Meta campaigns. Write persuasive direct-response copy across both short- and long-form advertising formats, applying frameworks such as AIDA and PAS. Analyse ad account performance, winning creative patterns, competitor approaches, emerging trends, and audience behaviour to identify opportunities for iteration. Translate performance insights into detailed, actionable briefs for designers, video editors, and UGC creators. Test, iterate, and optimise creative assets based on measurable performance data, prioritising conversion and commercial outcomes. Identify and replicate winning creative structures while developing meaningful variations for ongoing testing. Present regular creative performance reports with clear insights and recommendations for future testing. Maintain an organised creative pipeline, briefing process, testing roadmap, and supporting internal workflows. Contribute to landing-page messaging and structure for paid campaigns, helping improve the customer journey and conversion potential. Provide creative direction for website and product-page content and contribute to organic social strategy where relevant. Help maintain consistent messaging and creative direction across the broader customer journey. Collaborate closely with performance marketing, design, video, and content teams to ensure campaigns are delivered efficiently and to a high standard. Requirements 2+ years of experience in direct-response creative strategy for DTC e-commerce, gained in-house, at an agency, or as a freelancer. Strong hands-on understanding of Meta Ads, particularly within high-volume creative testing environments. Proven experience creating detailed creative briefs and directing designers, video editors, and UGC creators. Ability to analyse advertising performance data and translate findings into actionable creative recommendations. Strong direct-response copywriting skills and knowledge of proven conversion frameworks. Deep understanding of DTC consumer psychology, buyer motivations, attention triggers, and scroll-stopping principles. Highly data-driven approach, with the ability to prioritise performance outcomes over subjective creative preferences. Clear and fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal. Strong organisational skills with the ability to work independently, manage deadlines, and take ownership of deliverables. Proactive, commercially minded, detail-oriented, and comfortable working at speed while maintaining quality. Experience in health, wellness, supplements, or beauty is advantageous. jobgether-jobgether:lever:8102577b-922c-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Property Management Account Manager based in Ireland. This is a fully remote opportunity for an experienced property management professional to take ownership of a diverse portfolio and its day-to-day operations. rws-rws:lever:f53a2251-f96a-4fcc-b6ba-05.description: About the Role Are you detail-oriented, tech-savvy, and interested in helping train the next generation of Artificial Intelligence? seqholdings-seqholdings:ashbyhq:dd03d01b.description: ABOUT SEQUENCE Our mission is to own, transform, and operate the companies that will define the American service economy. AI will reshape every industry. But its deepest impact won't come from better models - it will come from transforming how real businesses serve real customers. Faster decisions. Personal service at scale. Better outcomes for the people who depend on these institutions every day. We believe this is the defining opportunity of our generation. The traditional playbook can't capture it. SaaS companies expect every business to conform to their product. Consultants scope to an engagement and leave. Neither has the access, context, or incentive to reach the root of how a business actually operates. That requires ownership. Sequence was built to close that gap. We are a permanent holding company - a home for great businesses and the exceptional people who run them. We take meaningful stakes, embed our technology and engineering team, and work alongside management to rewire operations from the inside. Not as a vendor. Not on a timeline. As owners. We've raised $75M - our seed round led by Conviction and 8VC, and our Series A led by Lux Capital - joined by Definition Capital, Chris Ré (Factory), and other leading institutional partners. ABOUT THE ROLE Forward Deployed Engineers are the tip of the spear at Sequence. You'll walk into an operating company and within weeks, you'll understand how the business works better than most people who've been there for years. Then you'll rebuild it. Your job is to translate human knowledge work into AI compute. The operator who spends three hours reviewing documents before making a decision. The sales team that maintains a pipeline in their heads because the tools don't work in the field. The compliance team that manually checks every transaction against a spreadsheet of rules. You'll find these workflows, build AI-powered systems that transform them, and ship production software that people use daily — not demos, not pilots, real systems that run real businesses. Every transformation you do feeds back into Sequence's core AI platform — so that services businesses start to feel like product businesses. The companies we acquire run on manual, human-intensive processes. By building reusable systems that compound across the portfolio, you make each subsequent transformation faster than the last. As Sequence grows, the best FDEs will define and lead entire verticals, working closely with operators and investors to shape how whole industries run on Sequence's platform. WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON - End-to-end AI transformations inside operating companies: discovery, scoping, building, shipping, and iterating until the business impact is measurable and undeniable - Production agentic systems — tool-calling workflows, LLM-powered document processing, intelligent routing, and automated decision support — built for reliability in regulated, high-stakes environments - Enterprise integrations with legacy systems, CRMs, compliance platforms, and operational software that was never designed for automation — including the auth, permissions, and data constraints that come with it - Reusable platform primitives that make the next transformation faster — data ingestion patterns, workflow orchestration, agent harnesses, and context layers that compound across the portfolio - Direct collaboration with management teams, front-line operators, and business leadership to understand their world and earn their trust REQUIREMENTS - Customer obsession. Has worked directly with users, changed direction based on what they learned, and genuinely cares about solving real problems for real people. This is the hardest quality to teach and the one we weight most heavily. - Demonstrated track record of impressive accomplishments, whether academic, professional, or entrepreneurial - Can operate in ambiguity. Comfortable walking into a business with no roadmap and figuring out what to build first by talking to people, not re

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:088c7a29-ac1.description: About the Role We are looking for detail-oriented Quality Control (QC) Specialist to support an AI data annotation project. In this role, you will review the work submitted by Trainers — pre-seeded questions paired with images and their corresponding "golden" answers — to confirm accuracy, consistency, and adherence to project guidelines. This is a task-based, remote-friendly opportunity ideal for individuals who are highly meticulous, observant, and skilled at spotting errors or inconsistencies that others may miss. What You'll Do Review completed tasks submitted by Trainers, including the original question, the image, and the golden answer provided Independently verify whether the golden answer is correct based on the image Identify and flag incorrect, incomplete, ambiguous, or inconsistent answers Provide clear, constructive feedback or corrections to help maintain overall data quality Track recurring error patterns and report them to the project team Ensure Trainer output meets the project's quality bar before final sign-off Escalate unclear cases (e.g., illegible images, ambiguous questions) to the project team for resolution What We're Looking For Native/Strong proficiency at Portuguese Bachelor's degree required Excellent attention to detail and a strong quality mindset Good visual observation and reading comprehension skills Ability to apply guidelines/rubrics consistently and objectively Strong written English communication skills, especially for giving feedback Prior experience in quality assurance, quality control, editing, proofreading, data review, data annotation or data labeling is a plus Reliable access to a computer and internet connection Work Format & Compensation Work Type: freelance, remote Hours/Schedule: 20 hours per week Compensation: $39.6/hr Duration: Long-term
